question: Does the unchanged GDT1193 output grammar even permit the already owned exact whole forms, including the manually inspected long form, under its fixed glyph map or any global bijective relabeling?
prior: 1193 basic statistical and old 16-group blinded-reader PASS retained; 1194/1195 later stronger notation failures retained. This is a distinct necessary output-alphabet argument, not a new source fit or another manual decryption. The likely contradiction is already informally noticed and fully exploratory.

known_whole_anchor: cheoltchedaiin f114r.39; old qualitative image review supports one close internal join and clear outside spacing. No new image or raw native data acquisition.
model_grammar: At least two glyphs; one initial from the union of the first21 initial-map positions; zero or more medial digits using the first3 medial-map positions; one final using the first6 final-map positions. Dictionary, counter and style can only narrow this language.
fixed_test: Record necessary literal-grammar violations for the nine preselected forms. Passing this relaxed grammar is not actual dictionary/counter acceptance.
permutation_test: For each whole remove exactly its first and last working glyph. More than3 distinct remaining glyph types is impossible under any one-to-one global relabeling of the fixed three medial glyphs. No permutation enumeration or table optimization.
outcomes: A witness establishes a hard conditional architecture exclusion independent of source table contents and glyph-name choice; if absent, keep the question inconclusive. Both outcomes retain the old diagnostic mismatches and no native adoption. This small manual proof does not justify implementation expansion.
assumptions: Each observed printed whole corresponds to one model group.
Frozen working units and distinctness are preserved by a bijective global relabeling.
No new boundary deletions, internal reset, scribal-error allowance or position-specific additional alphabet is inserted.
1195 has a different paired interior rule and is not automatically covered by this proof.
no_meanings: No native value, language, phoneme, morphology or translation assignment.
